stem: A nurse continually monitors the patient, team, environment, and progress toward the plan of care. This practice primarily supports which TeamSTEPPS concept?
rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS describes situation awareness as the outcome of continually monitoring the patient, team, environment, and progress toward the goal. A is correct.
educational_objective: Recognize continual situation monitoring as the basis for situation awareness.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
source_locator: Situation Monitoring overview — patient, team, environment, and progress
source_claim_supported: Situation awareness results from continual monitoring of the patient, team, environment, and progress toward goals.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care — team communication, coordination, and clinical oversight

source_original.stem: A nurse maintains ongoing awareness of a client's overall status, subtle changes, and the broader clinical context throughout a shift, allowing early recognition of a developing complication, and a student assumes this is just a personality trait some nurses happen to have rather than a teachable concept. This reflects the concept of:

options.A: Situational awareness means continuously monitoring the patient, team, environment, and progress
options.B: Situational awareness is an unstructured personality trait that cannot be taught or improved
options.C: Situational awareness applies mainly to aviation and has no direct patient-safety application
options.D: Situational awareness means focusing on one task while intentionally ignoring broader context

source_original.rationale: Situational awareness — originally studied extensively in aviation and other high-reliability industries — refers to the continuous perception and understanding of one's environment (in this case, a client's clinical status and broader context) to anticipate potential problems and respond effectively, an important concept increasingly emphasized in healthcare patient safety education.
source_original.source_detail: Situation awareness is the outcome of continual monitoring of patient, team, environment and progress; current TeamSTEPPS curriculum; accessed 2026-08-14.

correction_summary: Removed the personality-trait and aviation narrative, aligned the stem directly to TeamSTEPPS monitoring elements, and reduced difficulty to easy.

audit_findings.claim_audit: Final answer directly uses TeamSTEPPS monitoring dimensions.
audit_findings.blueprint: Team coordination fits Management of Care.
audit_findings.independent_second_pass: Rechecked TeamSTEPPS overview; A remains unique.
